traits.life_span.note: Hitchcock's genus description of Danthonia (p. 300-301): tufted, low or moderately tall perennials.

traits.rhizome_habit.note: Hitchcock's genus description of Danthonia (p. 300-301): tufted perennials, no rhizomes named for any species.

traits.clonal.note: Hitchcock's genus description of Danthonia (p. 300-301): tufted perennials; they make cleistogamous spikelets in the lower sheaths, but do not spread by rhizomes or stolons.
